requirements.title: Per-Item Retention Policy: Live, Held, and Pinned
requirements.description: Every item (file or text) carries a retention policy assigned at upload time: Live (deliver to currently connected devices then purge from server immediately after delivery or after a short grace window), Held (auto-purge after a configurable duration defaulting to 24 hours from upload time), or Pinned (retained until explicit owner deletion). The retention policy is stored in item metadata and enforced by a server-side purge scheduler. The scheduler must use injected clock and TTL seams to enable deterministic unit testing.

validation.notes: Unit test: Live item is scheduled for purge immediately after relay delivery is acknowledged, using mock clock seam
Unit test: Held item purge fires exactly at upload_time + configured_ttl using injected clock; default TTL is 24 hours
Unit test: Pinned item purge scheduler skips the item and does not enqueue it for deletion
Unit test: purge handler deletes both the blobstore object and the metadata record in a single atomic operation
Unit test: retention policy defaults to the owner's global default when not explicitly set on upload
Integration test: upload a Live item; assert it is delivered to Device B; assert metadata record and blob are deleted after delivery grace window
Integration test: upload a Held item with 1-minute TTL override; assert item exists at T+30s and is purged at T+65s
Integration test: upload a Pinned item; assert it persists after 25 hours with no scheduler deletion
Integration test: owner changes global default from Held to Pinned; next uploaded item without explicit policy is Pinned
Purge scheduler processes 1000 expired items per minute without impacting relay delivery latency
Playbook: upload items with each policy type; confirm correct policy badge renders in Receive pane
Playbook: confirm that Held item disappears from Receive pane after TTL elapses without manual deletion

requirements.title: Global Owner-Configurable Retention Default
requirements.description: The owner can configure a global default retention policy (Live, Held with custom TTL, or Pinned) in Settings. This default is applied at upload time to any item that does not carry an explicit per-item policy override. The default is stored in the owner's profile in the relational metadata store and is enforced server-side at ingest, not client-side, to prevent bypass. Changes to the default do not retroactively alter existing items.

validation.notes: Unit test: ingest handler reads the owner's global default when item payload omits explicit retention policy
Unit test: ingest handler uses the explicitly provided item-level policy when present, ignoring the global default
Unit test: global default update does not trigger a batch update on existing item retention policies
Integration test: owner sets global default to Pinned via Settings API; upload item without policy; assert item.retention == Pinned
Integration test: owner sets global default to Held(2h); upload item; assert purge fires at upload_time + 2h
Integration test: existing items uploaded before default change retain their original retention policy after the change
Playbook: navigate to Settings; change global default; upload a new item; confirm correct policy badge without explicit selection
